context.note: NativeBackend seam is open and ready for Android impl: lib/src/native_backend.dart documents platform-specific behavior (iOS Done vs Android back keyboard dismiss, attribute/value vs attribute/text readback, iOS consent_accept/alert_dismiss vs Android back key). The seam expects backend impl to handle all divergences internally — not in extension/tools.

AppiumBackend is iOS-only production implementation (~600 LOC): HTTP W3C WebDriver transport, XCUITest XML parsing, iOS-specific press key handling (consent_accept→POST /alert/accept, alert_dismiss→POST /alert/dismiss), iOS keyboard dismiss (Done button or no-op for iOS26). Pattern provides reference for UiAutomator2 XML parsing and Android keyboard dismiss (POST /back).

NativeSnapshot.platform field already supports both 'ios' and 'android' — no schema changes needed. FakeNativeBackend recognizes all keys (enter/return/done/consent_accept/alert_dismiss/back) so unit tests can exercise Android press behavior today.

CLI bin/leonard_native_host.dart exists (not created yet) and already accepts --platform flag, but always instantiates AppiumBackend regardless of platform value. Architect must wire platform-conditional backend selection (e.g., `if (platform == 'android') UiAutomator2Backend(...) else AppiumBackend(...)`)
Public API exports from lib/leonard_native.dart: AppiumBackend is exported, UiAutomator2Backend must be added post-implementation.

AppiumBackend documents hardening applied per m2-spec §5.5: B5 (HTTP status + non-JSON handling), FN3 (masked flag element-type-derived), FN4 (attribute/value vs attribute/text branching), B6 (Android keyboard dismiss non-fatal). UiAutomator2Backend must apply same pattern for Android.

Test patterns: appium_backend_test.dart uses MockClient for unit tests (no device); native_host_e2e_test.dart probes Appium reachability, self-skips on env vars. Android e2e will need LEONARD_NATIVE_APP_PACKAGE (instead of LEONARD_NATIVE_APP), LEONARD_NATIVE_APP_ACTIVITY, and Android emulator UDID.

Auth0 consent path: iOS has ASWebAuthenticationSession (separate SpringBoard alert, press('consent_accept')→POST /alert/accept). Android has Chrome Custom Tab (no separate system alert). Bead notes adaptive-consent path from lenny-qxx.5 should tolerate Chrome Custom Tab's absence — verify on live run.

Perception is pull-free (ADR-0006, in genesis not lenny): buildPerception() is synchronous, device latency lives behind NativeBackend seam. Out-of-band watcher (NativeExtension.initialize subscribes to backend.watch()) keeps NativeSnapshot current. No async I/O at observation time.

House conventions (memento house set): Dart ^3.11, melos, exhaustive switch, fakes not mocks, doc comments on public API, no print in lib, shared lints (strict-casts/inference/raw-types, prefer_single_quotes, unawaited_futures, avoid_print). Package uses xml (XCUITest parse) + http (W3C WebDriver); Android parser may differ.

violations.quote: /// The `NativeBackend` seam — the I/O boundary that keeps `buildPerception()` synchronous (ADR-0006). ALL device latency (WebDriver round-trips, a11y-tree polling) lives behind it; the extension never touches the device directly. `AppiumBackend` is the first concrete impl; `FakeNativeBackend` is the test impl; a later `UiAutomator2Backend` is purely additive.
violations.contradiction: CLI bin/leonard_native_host.dart does not wire --platform android to a UiAutomator2Backend impl. Currently always instantiates AppiumBackend regardless of platform flag, leaving the UiAutomator2Backend seam open.
